key_insight: PaddleMaterials unifies six materials-learning task classes in one toolkit while preserving task-specific representations and physical semantics.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can compose materials workflows and enable compiled execution with one setting, without changing model definitions.
method: Standardize data processing, training, evaluation and pretrained-model management.
Record physical quantities, units, aggregation conventions and references for verifiable cross-task composition.
Use a shared compiler backend for graph optimization, operator fusion and hardware-targeted code generation.
evidence_signal: Across 65 model instances in 11 groups, compiled execution accelerated every instance in eight groups; in the LiMnO2 case study, formation-energy errors were at most 7 meV/atom against same-geometry PBE+U references, with model-step costs below one-twentieth of a DFT single-point calculation.
watch_item: The reported case studies do not establish generalization across materials chemistries, and compiled acceleration was not universal across all model groups.
paper_title: PaddleMaterials: An End-to-End Deep Learning Toolkit for Materials Science
